summary: ProQR Therapeutics N.V. filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) for an underwritten public offering of 27,624,310 ordinary shares at $1.81 per share, with $47M net proceeds after discounts. Concurrently, a private placement to existing strategic partner Eli Lilly for 5,100,780 shares at the same price maintains Lilly's pro rata ownership. This is a conventional equity capital raise, not a special situation. The filing does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or abrupt management change. It is a routine shelf takedown to raise capital for general corporate purposes.
